cars.description: The Chevrolet Corvette ZR-1 (C4) comes with a 5.7L V8 engine, rear-wheel drive, and 375 horsepower. It's a true American muscle car, designed for performance and speed.
The Maserati Gran Turismo S is powered by a 4.7L V8 engine, rear-wheel drive, and delivers an impressive 433 horsepower. A blend of Italian elegance and performance.
The Dodge Viper SRT10 Coupe features an 8.3L V10 engine with rear-wheel drive, producing 510 horsepower. A true muscle car that delivers an intense driving experience.
The BMW Z8 is powered by a 4.9L V8 engine, rear-wheel drive, and generates 400 horsepower. A striking roadster that combines elegance with exhilarating performance.
The Audi R8 4.2 is equipped with a 4.2L V8 engine, all-wheel drive, and delivers 420 horsepower. A precision-engineered supercar that offers fantastic grip and power.
The Chevrolet Corvette ZR-1 (C6) packs a 6.2L V8 engine with rear-wheel drive, generating 638 horsepower. A high-performance sports car with world-class speed.
The Ferrari Testarossa is powered by a 4.9L V12 engine, rear-wheel drive, and produces 390 horsepower. A symbol of Ferrari's engineering prowess with a unique, timeless design.
The Ferrari Dino 246 GT comes with a 2.4L V6 engine, rear-wheel drive, and 180 horsepower. A lightweight and agile sports car that showcases Ferrari's expertise in performance.
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IV GSR features a 2.0L turbocharged inline-4 engine, all-wheel drive, and 276 horsepower. A rally-inspired car known for its handling and speed.
The Nissan R32 GT-R Vspec II is powered by a 2.6L turbocharged inline-6 engine, all-wheel drive, with 280 horsepower. A legendary JDM performance car with exceptional handling and speed.

cars.model: Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. SCP
cars.description: The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. SCP features a 2.0L turbocharged inline-4 engine, all-wheel drive, and 280 horsepower. A performance car designed for speed and rally dominance.
The Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG is equipped with a 6.2L V8 engine, rear-wheel drive, and 563 horsepower. A luxurious supercar that combines high-end performance with stunning design.
The Nissan Silvia K's (S13) features a 2.0L turbocharged inline-4 engine, rear-wheel drive, and 205 horsepower. A lightweight and agile car perfect for drifting and performance tuning.

The Honda Civic Type R (EK) Touring Car comes with a 2.0L turbocharged inline-4 engine, front-wheel drive, and 306 horsepower. A high-performance hatchback known for its handling and track capabilities.
The Porsche 911 Carrera RS CS (993) is powered by a 3.6L flat-six engine, rear-wheel drive, and 270 horsepower. A lightweight version of the iconic 911, designed for driving enthusiasts.
The Mazda RX-7 GT-X (FC) features a 1.3L twin-rotor rotary engine, rear-wheel drive, and 185 horsepower. A unique, rotary-powered sports car with excellent handling and performance.
The Lancia Stratos is powered by a 2.4L V6 engine, rear-wheel drive, and 190 horsepower. A rally legend known for its distinctive design and extraordinary off-road performance.
The Honda Civic Si Extra (EF) comes with a 1.6L inline-4 engine, front-wheel drive, and 108 horsepower. A small, lightweight car that offers great fuel efficiency and fun handling.
The Renault R5 Turbo features a 1.4L turbocharged inline-4 engine, rear-wheel drive, and 160 horsepower. A small and agile car built for performance and rallying.
The BMW 3.0 CSL is powered by a 3.0L inline-6 engine, rear-wheel drive, and 206 horsepower. A lightweight, racing-inspired coupe with a legacy in motorsport.
